name: Dictionary
summary: Look up words in an offline WordNet dictionary
description: Search headwords and read definitions, example sentences and synonyms. The dictionary data is on the phone, so no connection is needed.
author: thooton

changes.text: Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Show only the examples that use the word itself.
OK opens a word only the shorthand has even when the dictionary has longer words beginning with it.
OK on a word only the shorthand has, like into, opens that word.
Reopening goes home, and long headwords and the Word of the Day read whole.
Shorthand search reads phrases; Menu opens under the search capsule.
Shorthand gets a search of its own.
OK opens the Word of the Day at home.
